The abhorrent spectre is a superior variant of the aberrant spectre. It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master. Like their standard variant, a nose peg or Slayer helmet is required to safely engage them, as otherwise the player will take rapid damage and have their stats drained.

Drops

[edit | edit source]

In addition to 100% drops and tertiary drops, superior slayer monsters will always roll 3 additional items, of which only 1 roll may be from the superior unique table. The other rolls are performed on the regular counterpart's table; their displayed drop chances represent a single roll.

Drop rates are estimated based on 820,736 samples from the Drop Rate Project, unless otherwise cited.

The average Abhorrent spectre kill is worth 158,362.39.

The average Abhorrent spectre kill while on a Konar task is worth 262,293.84.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Their in-game models resemble and they use the same animations as giants, similarly to nechryarchs.
  • Their examine text is a reference to the Ape Atoll Agility Course, for which the player has to wear a Ninja or Kruk monkey greegree, effectively dressing as a monkey. 3145 laps of the agility course would amount to 1,824,100 Agility experience, enough to reach level 79 if a player started from level 48, the minimum Agility level required to complete the course.
